title: DP513 Stochastic Devaluation Risk and the Empirical Fit of Target Zone Models
title_zh: DP513 随机贬值风险与目标区模型的经验拟合
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper proposes a tractable and realistic nonlinear model of exchange rate dynamics, and argues that its predictions are consistent with available empirical evidence on exchange rate and interest differential behavior in real-life target zones. In our model, the exchange rate fluctuates between given boundaries for random lengths of time and jumps discretely when devaluations occur. We allow for stochastic variability in the likelihood and size of devaluations, and we provide explicit solutions for the stochastic processes followed by the exchange rate and by the expected rate of depreciation. The model produces realistic patterns of covariation between exchange rates and interest rate differentials, and provides interesting interpretations of available empirical evidence. We also specify how to infer devaluation risk from target zone data.
abstract_zh: 本文提出一个易于处理且贴近现实的汇率动态非线性模型，并论证其预测结果与真实目标汇率区中汇率与利差行为的现有实证证据一致。在该模型中，汇率在给定边界内随机时长波动，并在发生贬值时发生离散跳跃。我们允许贬值概率与幅度存在随机变化性，同时为汇率及预期贬值率所遵循的随机过程提供显式解。该模型生成了汇率与利差之间符合现实的协动模式，并对现有实证证据提供了有趣的解释。我们还阐明了如何从目标汇率区数据中推断贬值风险。

title: Congestion in Onboarding Workers and Sticky R&D
title_zh: 新员工入职拥堵与粘性研发
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Macroeconomics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: Adjusting the rate of R&D spending is costly if the probability of converting new hires into productive R&D workers ("onboarding") is decreasing in the number of hires ("congestion"). We show that such congestion induces R&D-producing firms to hire slowly in response to good shocks, and hoard workers in response to bad shocks, providing a microfoundation for the convex adjustment costs widely used to capture the delayed, hump-shaped response of R&D spending to shocks. Using novel, high-frequency productivity data on individual software developers collected from GitHub, we document quantitative evidence suggesting that congestion is an economically-significant feature of R&D investment production.
abstract_zh: 调整研发支出速度的成本高昂，前提是新员工转化为高效研发人员（即“入职适应”）的概率随招聘人数增加而下降（即“拥挤效应”）。我们证明，这种拥挤效应会促使研发型企业面对正向冲击时缓慢招聘，面对负向冲击时囤积员工，从而为广泛用于刻画研发支出对冲击呈现滞后驼峰型响应的凸调整成本提供了微观基础。通过从GitHub收集的个体软件开发者高频生产率数据，我们提供了量化证据，表明拥挤效应是研发投资生产中具有经济显著性的特征。

title: What Does Federal Oversight Do to Policing and Public Safety? Evidence from Seattle
title_zh: 联邦监督对警务与公共安全有何影响？来自西雅图的证据
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper investigates how federal oversight not precipitated by a major scandal influences policing behavior and public safety. The high-profile events triggering such scandals can independently affect policing and crime, confounding estimates of oversight effects. I examine a 2011 federal investigation into the Seattle Police Department. In response to the heightened scrutiny from the investigation, officers immediately and significantly reduced stops, particularly suspicious-activity and traffic stops in minority neighborhoods. These reductions had no detectable effect on public safety. I conclude that federal oversight implemented in the absence of scandals may lower the social cost of policing.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了并非由重大丑闻引发的联邦监督如何影响警务行为与公共安全。触发此类丑闻的高关注度事件可能独立影响警务与犯罪，从而混淆监督效应的估计。我研究了2011年对西雅图警察局的联邦调查。为应对调查带来的高度关注，警员立即显著减少了拦截行为，尤其是在少数族裔社区的嫌疑活动拦截和交通拦截。这些减少对公共安全未产生可察觉的影响。我得出结论：在无丑闻背景下实施的联邦监督可能降低警务的社会成本。

title: Predictable patterns of protest: The impact of agricultural cycles on social unrest in Kenya
title_zh: 可预测的抗议模式：农业周期对肯尼亚社会动荡的影响
official: 聚合元数据日期 2026-07-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper investigates how the agricultural cycle influences protest behavior in Kenya from 2000 to 2019. Using satellite data to identify the crop cycle and local harvest periods at the lowest available administrative level (wards) and geocoded protest records, we find that protest activity does not decline during the harvest period but increases with a temporal lag. A dynamic difference-in-differences specification shows that protest activity gradually rises in the two to three months following harvest, peaking around the onset of the subsequent agricultural cycle. These patterns are consistent with theories of opportunity costs and seasonal scarcity. While the opportunity costs of protest participation are highest during harvest periods, they decline thereafter and coincide with the lean season, when household food stocks become exhausted. These findings are robust across empirical specifications and contribute to a deeper understanding of the temporal dynamics of unrest in agrarian settings. They also highlight the importance of timing in the design of rural development and conflict prevention policies.

title: Financial and real effects of fiscal risk
title_zh: 财政风险的金融与实际效应
authors: Denis Gorea, Ding Xuan Ng, Fabrizio Zampolli
official: 官方在线 2026-06-28 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Focus We examine what happens when investors question fiscal sustainability and demand higher sovereign bond yields as compensation for higher risk. We call these episodes fiscal risk shocks. Such shocks can arise, for example, from a government announcing new spending or tax cuts, or from news that worsens its budget outlook. We develop a new method to identify these shocks from daily movements in bond yields. When fiscal concerns intensify, investors retreat from government bonds and shift towards the safest corporate bonds, resulting in negative co-movement in the yields of these bonds. Exploiting this relationship, we extract fiscal risk shocks for 12 economies. We then trace how these shocks propagate through exchange rates, equity markets, inflation and output.
abstract_zh: 焦点 本文研究当投资者质疑财政可持续性并要求更高的主权债券收益率以补偿更高风险时会发生什么。我们将此类事件称为财政风险冲击。例如，此类冲击可能源于政府宣布新增支出或减税，或源于恶化其预算前景的消息。我们开发了一种新方法，通过债券收益率的日常变动来识别这些冲击。当财政担忧加剧时，投资者会从政府债券中撤出，转向最安全的公司债券，导致这些债券收益率出现负向联动。利用这一关系，我们提取了12个经济体的财政风险冲击。随后，我们追踪这些冲击如何通过汇率、股票市场、通胀和产出进行传导。

title: Financial conditions and green R&D
authors: Luca Fornaro, Veronica Guerrieri, Will Hotten, Lucrezia Reichlin
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper studies how financial conditions affect research and development (R&D) by firms specialized in green innovation. Using U.S. patent data matched with Compustat, we identify “green innovators” as firms with a high cumulative share of green patents. Although they account for a small share of total green patenting, these firms occupy central positions in the green-innovation ecosystem. Estimating firm-level impulse responses to exogenous changes in broad financial conditions, we find that tightening has a disproportionately large and persistent negative effect on the R&D of specialized green innovators. In contrast, R&D by diversified innovators and non-innovators responds only weakly. Green innovators are younger, smaller, and more dependent on external finance, suggesting that financial tightening introduces a systematic bias against upstream green technological development.
abstract_zh: 本文研究金融状况如何影响专注于绿色创新的企业的研发活动。通过将美国专利数据与Compustat数据库匹配，我们将“绿色创新者”定义为绿色专利累计占比高的企业。尽管这些企业在绿色专利总量中占比很小，但它们处于绿色创新生态系统的核心位置。通过估计企业对外生广义金融状况变化的脉冲响应，我们发现金融紧缩对专业化绿色创新企业的研发产生了不成比例的大幅且持续的负面影响。相比之下，多元化创新者和非创新者的研发反应较弱。绿色创新者通常更年轻、规模更小且更依赖外部融资，这表明金融紧缩对上游绿色技术发展产生了系统性偏见。

abstract: We identify a novel channel of international financial contagion driven by investor expectations. Using a unique dataset linking investors' cross-country GDP growth expectations to their equity mutual fund investments and to funds' country allocations, we show that inflows into mutual funds respond strongly to fund-level expected growth, whereas funds' country allocations react only weakly to country-specific expectations. This asymmetry generates co-ownership spillovers: negative expectations about one country propagate mechanically to other countries held in the same funds, even in the absence of changes in the country

title: The Role of Special Economic Zones in Shaping Viet Nam’s Local Business Environment
title_zh: 经济特区在塑造越南本地商业环境中的作用
official: 官方在线 2026-05-29 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This study examines the effects of special economic zones (SEZs) on firm growth and the regional business environment in Viet Nam, highlighting their key role as a policy tool to attract foreign investors. Using detailed panel data from Viet Nam’s 63 provinces from 2006 to 2020 and instrumental variables (IV) estimations, this study provides new insights into how SEZs impact firm growth and several dimensions of economic governance. SEZs are found to play a dual role. Provinces with broader SEZ coverage experienced increases in employment, revenues, and the number of foreign-invested enterprises. In contrast, domestic private firms faced declines in both revenues and numbers. SEZ exposure had negative effects on several aspects of provincial economic governance including land access, transparency in policy-making, and informal charges. In addition, the approval of the first SEZ was also associated with increased prevalence of informal charges and preferential treatment of foreign-invested enterprises and other big companies, which may indicate heightened inefficiencies and rent-seeking concerns.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了越南经济特区（SEZs）对企业增长及区域营商环境的影响，凸显其作为吸引外资政策工具的关键作用。基于2006至2020年越南63个省份的详细面板数据，并采用工具变量（IV）估计方法，本研究揭示了经济特区如何影响企业增长及经济治理的多个维度。研究发现，经济特区发挥着双重作用。经济特区覆盖范围更广的省份，其就业、收入及外商投资企业数量均有所增长。相比之下，国内私营企业的收入与数量均出现下降。经济特区的设立对省级经济治理的若干方面产生了负面影响，包括土地获取、政策制定透明度及非正规收费。此外，首个经济特区的获批还与外商投资企业及其他大型企业非正规收费增加及优惠待遇加剧相关，这可能表明效率低下与寻租问题日益突出。
